items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Small + (risk flag or > 100 changed lines) now requires code completed-with-evidence or not_run + closed-vocab code; constant moved to shared/scripts/lib and re-exported by diff_risk_recheck.py; counting defined once and stated in sub-iterate-runner.md Step 3.7.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unmeasurable diff, missing trunk base, merge commit on trunk, corrupt plan or foreign risk_recheck all fail closed unless a flag already fires; a raising check reads RED via run_claim_checks.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, secrets or shell; git invoked via argument arrays; run_id path-safety checked before any file read.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real git repos per case: 100/101 boundary, removed lines, rename both sides, multi-commit branch, finalization exclusion, cross_component recompute, closed/contradicting/not_applicable codes, evidence bar.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: A handful of bounded git calls (30 s timeouts) per F11 run, only at small complexity.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Gate in its own verifiers/cascade_trigger.py + _cascade_trigger_inputs.py, registered in CLAIM_CHECKS; iterate_checks.py untouched; diff_risk_recheck.py stays 305, sub-iterate-runner.md stays 510.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumers of plan.json (classify_complexity) and risk_recheck.json (diff_risk_recheck) probed on this run's real artifacts: both read, flags ['touches_auth']; numstat parsing round-tripped against real git output in tests.
